title: Sample pack for the owner to approve the format

clips.name: Menu row press
clips.does: With the menu open, presses and holds the second row for 600ms, then lets go

source.note: In FK2 a right click on a layer or a row action opens ContextMenu (src/ui/components/ContextMenu). The harness renders that component with FK2's globals.css, opened at a point, with five rows and a separator. A reconstruction from source parts.

note: A run of pack R0.9 changed for this folder: clips menu-row-press; styles studio; devices pixel; schemes dark. It is evidence for the order, not part of its sample pack.
